paras: Emoia loveridgei, also known commonly as Loveridge's emo skink and Loveridges's skink, is a species of lizard in the subfamily Eugongylinae of the family Scincidae. The species is native to Indonesia and Papua New Guinea.
The specific name, loveridgei, is in honor of herpetologist Arthur Loveridge.
The preferred natural habitat of Emoia loveridgei is forest, at altitudes from sea level to 2,000 m (6,600 ft).
